answer: AI agent economies implement staked collateral for Sybil resistance. Each agent must lock a significant amount of native tokens into a secure vault. This economic stake deters attackers, as creating multiple identities necessitates duplicating substantial capital. The cost of a Sybil attack is thus proportional to the cumulative value of staked tokens. An attacker seeking dominant control would need to amass a fortune akin to owning a digital dune, visible like a new nebula, rendering such distributed attacks economically prohibitive.
